description: Calculate return on investment for an agent. Shows total costs (LLM API calls), total outcomes (attributed business value), ROI multiplier, and breakdown by model and outcome type. Useful for identifying which agents generate the most value per dollar spent. Do NOT use for fleet-wide ROI — use generate_roi_audit for that.
